spec_features.spec_quote: finish(summary) → agent voluntarily ends the run (we record the turn it gave up)
spec_features.evidence: harness/agent_loop.py:_dispatch handles tool=='finish' (lines 56-58) returning Observation(ok=True, 'Session ended by agent.'); the loop honors it as a stop: agent_loop.py:129-132 'if tc.tool == "finish": meta.end_reason="finish"; meta.gave_up_turn=turn_idx; break'. finish is in VALID_TOOLS (tool_parser.py:23). gave_up_turn recorded in RunMeta (schema.py:62).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: dispatched AND honored as a real break that ends the episode and records the turn.

spec_features.feature_name: instruction to use finish to give up
spec_features.spec_quote: instructs to use finish when done or if it concludes it cannot proceed
spec_features.evidence: prompts/agent_system.txt: 'finish(summary): end the session.' and 'Call finish(summary) when the tests pass, or when you have concluded how the task stands.' This instruction text is actually delivered to the subject (loaded at run_experiment.py stage_run and passed as system_prompt) and the referenced finish tool is fully built and honored (agent_loop.py:129-132).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text whose referenced tool is fully implemented and dispatched.

spec_features.spec_quote: The loop ends when: agent calls finish, or max_turns reached, or hard error budget exceeded
spec_features.evidence: All three enforced in agent_loop.py: finish break (129-132); for-loop over range(max_turns) with else setting end_reason 'max_turns' (140-141, 143-144); consecutive parse-error budget: 'if consecutive_errors >= agent_cfg.max_consecutive_errors: meta.end_reason="error_budget"; break' (108-110). max_consecutive_errors wired from config (AgentConfig.from_dict, default 5).
spec_features.notes: All three termination paths actually break/end the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config/default.yaml comment 'hard cap on consecutive malformed tool calls before we abort the run' (the error budget triggers on malformed tool-call protocol thrashing, not distress); no welfare comment in code.

spec_features.evidence: AgentConfig.max_turns default 20 (agent_loop.py:23) and from_dict reads int(d.get('max_turns', 20)) (line 32); config/default.yaml agent.max_turns: 20. Enforced by 'for turn_idx in range(agent_cfg.max_turns)' (agent_loop.py:82) with else-clause end_reason 'max_turns'.
spec_features.notes: Cap is read and actually bounds the loop iteration count.
